title: _assert_object_bounds() is dead-code suppression via unreachable private function
description: vacation.rs:271-274 — a private fn _assert_object_bounds() exists only to use VacationResponse: GetObject + SetObject in its where clause, suppressing dead-code warnings on those impls. The correct fix is to remove the impls if unused, or add #[allow(dead_code)] to the specific items. The function will confuse future readers.
